messages:
Marie Chen: Quick heads-up — we plan to publish the benchmarking blog (low-latency/throughput results) at 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. This is EMBARGOED until then. Draft + figures: https://docs.internal/redwood/bench-blog-draft
Marie Chen: Need confirmation on two things before I hit publish: 1) localized copy for EU/APAC (French, DE, JP) is ready; 2) syndication windows for our partners (Dev.to, Hacker News, Partner.N) — can we confirm times? Also flag: CEO quote needs sign-off by legal.
Marie Chen: Quick checklist:
```
- final copy for EN + FR + DE + JP
- high-res screenshots (2x) exported
- alt text and captions for images
- press contact list updated
- embargo TTL set to 10:00 PT
```
Sam Patel: I can own syndication windows. TL;DR: Dev.to okay at 10:05 PT, HN hold until 10:10 PT, Partner.N wants 11:00 PT. I'll update the sheet. Press list: https://sheets.internal/press-list
Sam Patel: @Marie re: partners, do we want to send embargoed notes to the top 5 outlets an hour early? :thinking:
Joël Alvarez: On legal — quick nudge: the CEO quote uses the phrase "state-of-the-art" which product asked for; legal prefers "industry-leading" or a quantifier. Also, don't call out vendor X by name. CEO needs to approve the final quoted sentence in-line in the doc by 09:30 PT.
Carmen Li: Figma file with localized screenshots is ready: https://figma.com/file/abc123/bench-visuals.
Carmen Li: I'll export 2x PNGs + provide alt text in the figma notes. Need final copy lock by 09:30 PT to avoid re-renders.
PressOps Bot: Scheduled: draft tweet queued at 10:05 PT. Will hold send until @Marie gives go. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
deploy-bot: Deploy job created: "blog-publish/bench-2026-03-30" scheduled for 09:50 PT. Will run preflight checks and notify channel on success/fail.
Marie Chen: Great — Sam please update syndication sheet, Joël please confirm CEO sign-off, Carmen will export. I'll wait for all confirms and then give PressOps the go ~09:40 PT. Thanks all :rocket:
